title: Tightened Bounds Reduced Step-Size Refinement
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining HfO2 thickness upper bounds to 250 nm and initializing thicker layers (indices 4-7) at 180-220 nm will reduce interference-phase oscillations that caused physics_violation and solver_disagreement in iteration 11, while maintaining sufficient optical path difference for spectral selectivity.
design_principle: Admittance locus method with bounded thickness optimization; reduced step-size dampens oscillations while preserving quarter-wave interference physics at visible-NIR transition.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Al substrate; exactly 9 finite layers
manufacturing_considerations: total layer count exactly 9 layers within 20-layer limit
HfO2 thickness capped at 250 nm for deposition uniformity
reduced optimizer step-size for convergence stability
theory_basis: Admittance Locus Method for metal-dielectric multilayer optimization
Five-step optimization workflow for optical thin films
DMD interference design principle for spectral selectivity
expected_advantages: Reduced physics_violation frequency due to tighter bounds
Improved solver agreement with reduced step-size
Maintained spectral selectivity with constrained optical path
known_risks: Reduced step-size may require more optimization iterations
execution_request_english: Optimize a 9-layer planar multilayer stack on aluminum substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2 | SiO2 | Cr | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2. Wavelength range 400-2000 nm with dual-band objectives: maximize absorptance in 400-700 nm, maximize reflectance in 700-2000 nm. Thickness bounds: layers 1-3 and 9 at [25, 250] nm initialized at 100 nm; layers 4-7 (thicker dielectric layers) at [180, 220] nm initialized at 200 nm; layer 8 (HfO2) at [25, 250] nm initialized at 150 nm. Chromium layer (layer 3) bounded at [5, 50] nm initialized at 20 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with reduced step-size schedule (initial step 0.5 nm, minimum step 0.01 nm). Total layer count fixed at 9. Evaluate target_score, robustness_score, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 400-700 nm, 700-2000 nm. soft objectives: high absorptance in 400-700 nm; low reflectance in 400-700 nm; high reflectance in 700-2000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high reflectance in 400-700 nm; high absorptance in 700-2000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 20.
revision_reason: Applied feedback directives: shifted initialization ranges for layers 4-7 downward to 180-220 nm, capped HfO2 upper bounds at 250 nm, reduced optimizer step-size to dampen interference-phase oscillations observed in iteration 11 physics_violation and solver_disagreement failures.
